title: Decisions after J1 read the F0 reference panel from J1_diag_decision_r2.json, not the J1_diag_decision.json file named in the protocol text
what_the_protocol_text_says: qualification_rule.q0.f0_panel_reference: 'J1 arm A0 (cuda:0) F0 train+holdout panels, carried in decisions/J1_diag_decision.json'
why: J1_diag_decision.json has verdict STOP (DEV-001: the tf32_off checker bug). r4_fs_decide.py refuses any diag decision whose verdict is not PASS as a reference, so the J2 decision could not be produced from the original file.
J1_diag_decision_r2.json (verdict PASS) is the coordinator-approved re-decision of the SAME J1 run (pt-56auspj8) under DEV-001.
effect: None on any number: the reference F0 panel content is byte-for-byte the same J1 arm A0 panel; only the file carrying it differs from the protocol text. Each decision records the file it used, with its sha256, under inputs.diag_decision.
